test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: The National flower of India is __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lotus**__.

**Lotus:**

__
 
• **It is the national flower of India**__.
 
• Its scientific name is Nelumbo Nucifera Gaertn.
 
• It is a sacred flower.
 
• It is also known as Bean of India.
 
• It is considered an auspicious symbol of prosperity.
 
• **It has an Indian identity and heritage**.
